curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Goku perfect a new technique to defeat the monster found with Tapion in the music box?
curatedMovie.description: The Z Warriors open a music box with Dragon Balls and find Tapion, sealed inside with a monster called Hildegarn.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting, and accessible, offering high-stakes animated action that works easily for group movie nights.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at 51 fast-paced minutes, Mitsuo Hashimoto’s film delivers lean, suspenseful martial arts spectacle centered on a massive threat and Goku's push to master a new skill.

facts.title: Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon
